column4: an output flag glued to its value (sort -o<file>) must stay one word a flag screen can read
a git -c value before the subcommand, quoted mid-word, must keep its quote position
a git -c alias whose value runs a shell (!sh) must stay one quoted word
an inline VAR= prefix with a quoted value must show its = unquoted and its value quoted
a bare parenthesis, which fish reads as a command substitution, must surface as an operator
a >& redirect to a file name, not a descriptor, must surface as a redirect with its target
a verb named by path (/x/cat, ./rm) must keep its path in the word
a .. path and a leading tilde must reach the containment check, the tilde flagged as an expansion
an unparseable command must emit nothing at all, not the tokens before the failure
an awk program redirecting print stays one quoted word, never a shell redirect
a case-insensitive config key must reach the screen with its case unchanged
a command substitution inside double quotes still runs, so it must be recorded on the quoted word
